verdicts.reason: A reflows the two-line headline onto one bold line that fills the strip and stays legible, but it is jammed against the canvas edges with almost no margin, so the airy, centred minimalism of the original is gone. B keeps the centred whitespace, but the headline is shrunk to tiny type that floats in a lot of empty space; it reads as a scaled-down copy with weak legibility at the target size.
